source_review_scope: Previous independent reviewers read all84 Oracle/Rust/full pinned direct Java and relevant helpers. This author reread complete Oracle/direct Rust/full direct Java for newly exercised MSH cards and the relevant focused reusable helpers. Exact direct Java hashes and unchanged inherited definitions verified here. This does not claim recursive review of all interfaces or base classes.
rules_limits: Scenario references discharge the stated outcomes in their parameter families, not every imaginable interaction. Shared keyword cases combine exact card/recipe/layer assertions with actual generic combat decisions; they do not require one separate bot per card.

Setup uses bounded owned scenarios and mana fixtures; spells, activations, targets, payments and choices use normal legal checked actions. Selected adversarial controller/zone changes and one typed noncombat damage batch are explicit event fixtures.
Every checked action verifies wrong-actor atomicity, owned raw/index branches after parent disposal, snapshot restore and stale revision. Invalid choices additionally preserve snapshot and revision.
Generic deterministic per-card cast traces remain regression shape evidence only, separate from these rules scenarios.
Full set-only legal-deck games covering all colors/mechanics, terminal outcomes, deterministic replay, owned search and simulation performance remain pending.

latent_gap.detail: Current instruction filters creatures. A noncreature Kindred Hero would also need a counter. Prior audit found no reachable supported producer; this is a latent semantic restriction, not a confirmed current-pool gameplay failure. Creature Hero/controller/replacement/vigilance behavior has meaningful scenarios.
latent_gap.status: pending supported reproducer and coordinated typed permanent-filter prerequisite

validation.linker: Regenerated with no changes to linked catalogue, metadata or coverage
validation.format: Direct rustfmt and git diff --check pass
validation.full_release: Parent integrator runs python3 scripts/validate.py --release on final combined cohort; no standalone full-release claim here
